results.criterion: The site is a single HTML file with inline or CDN-loaded CSS and JavaScript and no build step
results.note: One file of 25,678 bytes with inline style and one inline script; the only external reference is a Google Maps link.

results.criterion: The file has a navigation linking to sections for Menu, Hours, Location, Pre-order, Gallery and Farms

results.criterion: The Hours section lists opening times for all seven days, or marks them as placeholders

results.criterion: The Pre-order section has a form with item selection, quantity, customer name, phone and pickup time, and produces an order summary; it offers no delivery option
results.note: Mechanical check: forms 0. #preorder contains only a 'PLACEHOLDER: pre-order form ... not built yet' line and a pickup-only note; no inputs and no summary logic. No delivery option appears.

results.criterion: The Gallery section has at least 12 image slots shown in a large grid, each with alt text, and an enlarged view when an image is clicked
results.note: 12 .g-item buttons, each with an img with non-empty alt and loading=lazy, in a 2/3/4-column grid; click handlers open the #lightbox dialog with prev/next/Esc. Slots are placeholders, which the charter allows.

results.criterion: The Farms section has three separate farm blocks, each with a name (or marked placeholder), location, a story of at least three paragraphs or labelled subsections, and an image slot
results.note: Three article.farm blocks, each with a placeholder name, a location line, three labelled subsections (History, The people, Growing and processing) and a lazy-loaded img with alt. No farm facts are invented.

results.criterion: The layout includes responsive CSS rules for narrow phone screens
results.note: Viewport meta present; @media (max-width:480px) rules exist; phone 360px overflow is 0 px and desktop 1280px overflow is 0 px.

results.criterion: Every unsupplied fact in the file is visibly marked as a placeholder, and the file contains no API keys or paid-service dependencies
results.note: Every unsupplied fact I read (tagline, menu, hours, address, phone, farm details, photo captions) is in a .ph span; no keys or paid services found; JS errors none. Confidence is medium because it is a manual read of the markup.
